answerMasking.method: grid-aligned five-source median; source bubble disks replaced by the median

staticFeatureMask.policy: fixed header + question-number strips + fixed footer; answer bubbles and user-populated fields excluded

templates.aggregation: highest-confidence aligned static-print anchor with all 200 bubble disks replaced by the five-source median
templates.answerIndependence: all-A/all-B/all-C/all-D/random guarantees at least three unmarked samples per answer cell
